company_name: Shanghai Jufluorine Plastic Technolgy Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: None — The company specializes in PVDF products for food, pharmaceuticals, and drinking water, not semiconductors.
summary: Shanghai Jufluorine Plastic Technology Co., Ltd specializes in the production of PVDF materials, particularly KYNAR, which is used in packaging, transportation, and storage for the food, pharmaceutical, and drinking water markets. The company emphasizes high-quality, additive-free products with excellent physical, mechanical, and chemical properties.
capabilities: KYNAR product line with FDA certification

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shanghai with facilities in Qingpu District.
